name: Hiking
description: Hiking word search puzzles gather trail English for adults and seniors — pack, boot, ridge, switchback, cairn and quiet outdoor words — without gear brands or park trademarks. Every grid is free online with no download, no account and no timer. Choose easy across-and-down warm-ups, medium grids with diagonals, hard puzzles in all eight directions, or large print with bigger letters on a smaller board. The list stays familiar and unhurried: compass, meadow, stream, summit, vista and rest-stop vocabulary many walkers already know from day hikes. This hub sits under our Camping collection and pairs well with Mountains, Forests and National Parks when you want a longer outdoor session. Prefer bigger type? Start with large print. New solvers can read how to play, then pick a difficulty as steady as a contour line.
